lines.text: Paul and other prisoners are handed to a centurion named Julius and board an Adramyttian ship with Aristarchus.
They land at Sidon, sail to the lee of Cyprus, and at Myra Julius puts them on a ship from Tyre.
At Fair Havens Paul warns of disaster, but the centurion follows the pilot and the owner, and most decide to sail on.
A gentle south wind begins, then a cyclone called the Northeaster hits, and they pass Cauda and lower the sea anchor.
An angel tells Paul he must preach in Jerusalem and that God has granted him the lives of all who sail with him.
